verdict.rationale: Firstbase offers its own registered agent service in all 50 states at $299 per state per year, and that role inherently involves receiving legal notices. However, the evidence never explicitly describes service-of-process handling, a street-office location for the agent, or SOP scanning into the account. The mail-scanning claim (docs-11) belongs to the separate physical business address offering, so it does not transfer to this story. Missing for 10: explicit service-of-process acceptance, a documented physical street office for the agent, scanning of SOP into the account, any same-day turnaround commitment, and independent corroboration.
